provider.why: This is the still-image model already set as image_model. RunPod on this project captures Hypit in Chrome. It is not an image model. No second still provider is connected.

templates.icon: Premium minimal line icon of {concept}, one consistent thin stroke, geometric, gold #E0B15A on a fully transparent background, centered, lots of padding, editorial not cute, no fill clutter, no text, no letters, no numbers, no logo, no watermark, no mockup frame.
templates.concept: Premium editorial object illustrating {concept}, single subject, thin gold and cool-blue lines, subtle depth, isolated on a fully transparent background, enough padding to animate, no scenery, no text, no letters, no numbers, no logo, no watermark.
templates.lifestyle: Premium cinematic photograph of {scene}, natural faces and hands, soft window light, modern and quiet, subject placed {placement}, empty space for later typography, no text, no logo, no watermark, no captions.
templates.document: A small stack of blank off-white cards, slight fan, soft shadow, abstract gray horizontal rules where text would be, one simple green check mark, no letters, no words, no numbers, no logo, transparent background.
templates.globe: Minimal wireframe globe, cool blue latitude lines on transparent background, four small gold dots connected by one dashed route, no country names, no labels, no text, no watermark.

notes: The word watermark in a prompt makes this model refuse the picture. Lifestyle prompts omit it.
The model paints a checkerboard into RGB instead of returning alpha. Five foregrounds were keyed to real PNG alpha. The glossy target was left as generated because keying left a dirty halo.
Do not scale the library until the target illustration is redrawn in the same line language as the goal icon, and the two icons move to SVG.
